# Hats

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** Hats

## What it does

Hats is a purely cosmetic render feature that floats a decorative shape above a player's head. Pick from six styles — a spinning cone, a glowing halo, orbiting orbs, a flower, a star, or your own custom image — and tweak its size, colors, and spin to make it your own.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/render/hats). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
